decisions.reason: 등을 돌렸다 is a departure; “turned away” avoids the ambiguity of “turned around” (which can mean facing them).
Korean line 57 is one utterance starting with ……, not a silent beat plus a separate line.
Restores the source ellipsis onto the same speech line instead of a standalone pause.
화수분 is an inexhaustible food vessel; “bottomless pot” fits the dumpling joke better than “spring.”
새하얗게 샌 is snow-white hair; “snow-white” renders 새하얗게 more precisely than “completely white.”
헛다리 짚다 is idiomatic as “barking up the wrong tree,” and the ellipsis matches 말꼬리가 흐려졌다 better than a cut-off dash.
Merges the trailing sentence and keeps 감탄했다 as Jeok Cheongang being impressed, not the two men being impressive.
The separate “they were impressive” line is absorbed into the merged sentence; deleting it restores the source unit.
SOL restores 버릇없게 and 쩝쩝대 but drops 이미 and weakens 완숙한 from “mature” to “seasoned.”
decisions.replacement: The one rudely smacking away on dumplings in front of an elder, especially, had already reached a fully mature Peak realm. It would not be an exaggeration to say so.

decisions.reason: BASE wrongly uses first-person “I” in Jeok Cheongang’s third-person POV; SOL flattens 있을까? into a declaration and loses the speculative tone.
decisions.replacement: *Would only the Elders of the Nine Sects and One Gang he had crossed paths with a few times in the past be able to compare?*

decisions.reason: Restores 반면에 and the trailing ellipsis that BASE dropped.
Cleaner present-tense observation, and “ought to just” captures impulsive 확 파 버릴라 better than hedged “maybe I should.”
Same spoken line as H006; keep the idiomatic trailing-off rendering consistent in Jeok Cheongang’s POV.
SOL captures 혹시 but drops glossary “demonic, heterodox arts”; BASE keeps the term but misses the speculative 혹시.
decisions.replacement: “The Jin Family of Taiyuan? Any chance it practices demonic, heterodox arts?”

decisions.reason: Restores omitted 그래? and uses the glossary form “Jin Family of Taiyuan.”
Keeps 순간 as “for an instant” and drops BASE’s unsupported “the sight of it.”
This 예? is confused non-comprehension of “How?”, not an affirmative; “Pardon?” matches the beat.
BASE mistranslates 불편하게 as “strange”; SOL’s appended “elder” calques 어르신 that English “you” already covers.
decisions.replacement: “The truth is, I use something called the System. It’s a bit of a cheat, so it might have felt uncomfortable to you. I’m sorry.”

decisions.reason: Naturalizes 입을 연 것은 잠시 후였다 as a delayed reply instead of a literal mouth-opening beat.
“Then he opened his mouth” is a Korean-calque leftover once the delay is already in the prior sentence.
The …… belongs on Taekyung’s reply, not as a silent line after Jeok Cheongang’s outburst.
Moves the source ellipsis onto the speech where 있는 그대로 begins.
Restores the named roster 나, 청풍, 혁무진, 장태보 and 이 자리에 that BASE genericized to “anyone present.”
화아아악 is a heat/flame rush, distinct from earlier 슈우우욱; “Fwoooosh” marks the fire SFX.
